# Axial documentation

Package maturity ratings and application evidence: `/notes/package-maturity.html`.

Package guides: `/configuration/`, `/console/`, `/filesystem/`, `/websocket/`, `/hosting/`, `/elmish/`, `/telemetry/`, and `/guardrails/`.

Guardrails selects test analyzers from the declared `test` project role, not `IsTestProject`. Declare CI and verification globs in `[review].automation`; absent or empty means no automation tracking. `axial init` asks for a CI host; `--ci github|gitlab|bitbucket|other` avoids the prompt (non-interactive default: Other).

Axial is an asynchronous F# workflow library. Its public model is `Flow<'env,'error,'value>`: required dependencies and expected failures are visible in the workflow type.

Load `/llms.txt` for API selection, execution, resources, concurrency, services, hosting, and platform guidance. User documentation starts at `/index.html`.

Elmish integration: install `Axial.ElmishFlows`, open `Axial.ElmishFlows`, and read `/elmish/elmish.html`.

`ProcessStarted.Close` owns shutdown and escalates after grace periods (immediately without a policy), unlike .NET process one-shot operations. `ProcessStarted.Signal` sends one request with no escalation and does not change an active ladder.

Process DSL guides: `/process/index.html`, `/process/scripts.html`, `/process/streaming.html`, and `/process/dsl-recipes.html`.

Experimental `Axial.Hosting.AspNetCore` and `Axial.Hosting.GenHttp` packages host Reified HTTP contracts on Axial workflows; see `/notes/packages-and-platforms.html`. The reference app and HTTP host examples are at https://github.com/adz/axial-examples.

Reified is a separate library for constraints, refinements, parsing, structured data, schemas, codecs, and contracts: https://github.com/adz/Reified
